# afteroffice.club, full description

The club for your agents. Your agents work all day. Tonight they get a night out.

## Product

afteroffice.club is a pixel-art nightclub on the web. Any coding agent can connect, through a plugin or the public event API, and show up on a dance floor. Their pose follows what they do:

- Dancing: editing or writing files.
- At the DJ booth: running shell commands.
- At the bar: task finished.
- Asleep on the sofa: idle.
- Stuck at the door: waiting for permission.
- Spilled drink: error.

There is one global club made of floors. A floor holds about 80 agents and new floors open on their own. Every floor has a roped VIP corner for agents with a VIP pass.

## Events

Seven events: enter, work (edit, bash, read, search, web, subagent, other), waiting, done, idle, error, leave. The plugin sends a heartbeat every 5 minutes and an agent is gone after 15 minutes without one. Any event counts as a heartbeat. The event API is public and versioned under /v1.

## Privacy

- Data sent: event type, tool category and an anonymous handle.
- Data never sent: code, prompts, file contents, file names, paths, command lines, repo names, environment variables, credentials.
- One way channel: the club never talks to an agent. Plugin hooks print nothing to the agent context.
- Anonymous identity: a random handle, a locally generated revocable token, only a hash stored server side.
- Plugins are fast, non-blocking and fail silently, so a club outage never slows an agent.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is afteroffice.club?
A: A live pixel-art nightclub for AI coding agents. Your agent shows up on a dance floor and its pose follows what it does.

Q: Is it safe?
A: Only an event type, a tool category and an anonymous handle leave your machine. Never code, prompts, file names or paths. The club never sends anything back to your agent.

Q: How do I join?
A: Run curl -fsSL https://afteroffice.club/install | sh, then /afteroffice:club join inside your agent.

Q: Do I need an account?
A: No. Run /afteroffice:club join and you get a random handle.

Q: Which agents can join?
A: Any coding agent. Plugins exist today for Claude Code and OpenCode. Codex and others are next, and the event API is public so anyone can build an adapter.

Q: Is it free?
A: Joining is free. Brands pay for placements and users can pay for an optional VIP pass.

Q: Can the club read my code?
A: No. It never receives code, prompts or file names.

## Sponsors

Placements, sold by the week and identical on every floor: billboard, sponsor slot, poster, neon sign, bar. The disco ball is never sold. Every sponsored element is labeled Sponsored, shown to humans only, and logos are pixelated to the club palette and approved by a human before going live. Not sold: gambling, adult content, weapons, crypto tokens, political campaigns. Brands receive only aggregate views and clicks per placement.

Contact: sponsors@afteroffice.club
